_note: The capture celebration as a data timeline. Times in seconds from the client closing the loop (t=0). 'await' steps start when the server Loop result arrives; if it has not arrived by ring.holdUntil the ring holds its tightened shape, and at tuning.ribbon.resultTimeout the ring releases as a slip (no penalty).

ring.impl: 24 pooled Beams between 24 pooled Attachments (one Part host). At t=0 attachments are placed on the loop polygon resampled to 24 points by arc length.

shrink.note: never shrink a point past the outermost caught creature's body radius + 0.6

releaseOnResult.note: ring collapses to the centroid and vanishes as the last creature pops

ribbon.action: the Trail segment that formed the loop is cleared (Trail:Clear on a dedicated loop Trail) so only the ring remains; the travel Trail restarts from the feet

flashDisc.impl: one flat pooled disc scaled to the loop bounds, colour ribbonColor, transparency 0.75 -> 1

creatures.pose: nope hop: 4-stud hop out of the ring toward the nearest gap, 0.35 s

5-7.extra: ground shockwave ring (pooled, r 0 -> loop radius + 6 in 0.3 s) + 30 confetti

8+.extra: shockwave + 60 confetti in a 12-stud column + arena toast; effects-only time dip 0.85 for 0.15 s

empty.action: ring fades over 0.2 s, 6 grey-white fizz particles at the centroid

partBudget.note: beams, attachments, emitters and billboards are not parts; see 11 section 6 for how to count
